## About
FFF Roofing Specialist Inc works out of 1625 Almaden Rd in San Jose, in the heart of the Silicon Valley. We take on industrial, commercial, institutional, residential and custom jobs. No job is too small or too big.
Our crews handle pitch and low slope roofs, hot mop, single-ply and waterproofing, with tile, shingles, composite, acrylic and energy efficient materials. Whatever your needs are, we'll do it fast and clean.
Call the main office and Paty Nava will get you started. Frank Camolinga handles estimates, and Ray Gonzalez manages projects.

## Services
- Re-Roof & New Roof: Full tear-off re-roofs and new roofs. Whatever your needs are, we'll do it fast and clean.
- Hot mop: Built-up hot mop systems, including a four ply system we installed at the Verve apartments in Mt. View.
- Single ply roofing: Single ply and overlay single ply systems, including work at the Living Spaces store in Millbrae.
- TPO roof single ply: TPO single ply roofing for custom homes, like a recent job in Atherton.
- 2-piece clay tile: Clay tile roofing for custom homes, including a job in Los Altos Hills.
- Gutters and downspouts: Crews for gutter and downspout work.
- Waterproofing: Waterproofing crews for roofs and the areas around them.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of jobs do you take?
A: Industrial, commercial, institutional, residential and custom jobs. No job is too small or too big.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: All the cities in the Bay Area and Central Valley, plus some selected cities in Nevada.

Q: Is there any obligation if I call?
A: No. Feel free to call or send a message. No obligations.

Q: When is the office open?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Wednesday 8:00 AM – 5:05 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
